config.note: Farm ROI unchanged [-50,50]^2; separate flat west apron outside farm. Extended terrain grid is for flight checking, not enlarged sensor ROI.

scenario.generator: Python random.Random(seed); successive uniform X then Y draws
scenario.placement: Full original farm ROI; no minimum spacing, rejection or load balancing
scenario.terrain: Same triangulated mesh; antenna at ground + 0.65 m

mission.scope: Airborne reference only; no ROS/PX4/Gazebo execution or measured radio/battery.

budget.derivation: ceil(max launch + 2 s); ceil_to_0.25(max incremental service drift + 0.25 s); global 3 s
budget.scope: Development calibration, including seed404; future replay is same-case verification, not unseen validation.

arm_deadline_prediction.caveat: Conservative design reserve based on development flights; not a statistical or worst-case guarantee.

search.method: deterministic multistart + 2-opt/insertion; smooth-cruise segment duration search
search.optimality: No global optimum or infeasibility proof

summary.scope: Same reference geometry and service, preserving baseline segment stretch
